_about: Models and brands already checked and not held, so a sweep re-checks them only once recheckAfter has passed. Seeded 2026-11-26 from the BEV and PHEV wave logs (now in docs/archive/). Validated by data/watchlist.test.js.

entries.name: Porsche Taycan
entries.note: Sedan, ~8 variants. Base ~$175,100; flagships over $250,000 are unrepresentable, so split at the ceiling.

entries.note: SUV.

entries.note: Verify orderable: first deliveries were due Q3 2026.

entries.name: Renault Megane E-Tech facelift
entries.note: Family removed 2026-11-26: Techno EV60 run-out (POA), MY27 Esprit Alpine deposit/register-interest only on renault.com.au. Press: sole grade, $55,990 before ORC (CarExpert/The Driven/EV Central 28 Oct 2026), deliveries H1 2027. Re-add with new id renault-megane-e-tech-esprit-alpine when priced in the configurator.

entries.name: BYD Atto 3 Essential run-out
entries.note: Reviews call the Essential outgoing; still orderable 2026-11-26. Delete row byd-atto3-essential when it leaves the configurator.

entries.name: BMW i4
entries.note: Gone from BMW AU line-up; replaced by the new i3 sedan (sweep 2026-11-26). Family removed.

entries.name: Mercedes-Benz EQB
entries.note: Replaced by the electric GLB (sweep 2026-11-26). Family removed.

entries.name: BMW X5 50e (new generation)
entries.note: Old X5 50e is run-out stock only; family removed 2026-11-26. New X5 50e due Q2 2027: research as new under the same id.

entries.name: Maserati Grecale Folgore
entries.note: Family removed 2026-11-26: MY2025 Folgore absent from MY2026 AU line-up (CarExpert, CarsGuide, carsales list GT/Modena/Trofeo only); maserati.com/au 403. Refreshed Folgore expected H1 2027. Last held list $207,500.

entries.name: BMW iX3 40 (RWD)
entries.note: $89,900 before ORC (CarExpert 6 Nov 2026), deliveries Q4 2026; orderability unconfirmed (bmw.com.au 503). Near the $91,661 threshold. Add as bmw-ix3-40 when on the configurator.

entries.name: BMW iX3 M60
entries.note: Australian launch unconfirmed, expected 2027.

entries.name: Audi Q4 e-tron RWD 150kW (MY27)
entries.note: SUV and Sportback $71,650 MLP; ordering details later, H1 2027 arrival. 59 kWh net, EU WLTP 440/451 km. New ids audi-q4-e-tron-rwd / -sportback-rwd.

entries.name: Zeekr 7X Black Edition Package
entries.note: MY27 Black Edition is an option pack on Performance AWD, price unannounced; CarsGuide lists $75,990 Black Edition line. Confirm whether it is a separate price line.

entries.name: Deepal S07 update
entries.note: Held S07 is run-out stock (while stocks last). Updated S07 (possibly REEV) teased Oct 2026. Move to not-on-sale if stock clears.

entries.name: Chery New E5 (MY27)
entries.note: Facelift of the same car, coming soon, unpriced. Same family and id when it launches.

entries.name: Volvo XC60 PHEV long-range (MY27)
entries.note: MY26 T8 in run-out; long-range T8 (~189 km WLTP AU spec) due Q2 2027.

entries.name: Mercedes-Benz EQA run-out
entries.note: Run-out; replaced by electric GLA (mid-2027). Remove the family when it leaves the configurator.

entries.name: VW ID.5 run-out
entries.note: No MY27; dealer stock only (MY26 Pro, MY25 GTX). Remove the family when VW Offers & Pricing drops the ID.5 carlines.
